descriptionChirho: To engage in speech interchange involving persuasion or argumentation; used of Paul reasoning in synagogues, debating with opponents, or formal disputation; the standard NT deponent middle sense of dialogical discourse aimed at persuading or proving a point.

To speak or address someone with authoritative communication; used of Scripture 'speaking' or 'addressing' a hearer, with less emphasis on back-and-forth interchange and more on direct communication or exhortation.
